name: claude-kit
description: A personal Claude Code kit — a mentor that coaches and grades how you ask, and a critic that judges and grades what came back.

plugins.name: kit
plugins.description: Two operators, both measured. The mentor coaches the framing of a request before the work runs and grades the ask (framing, leverage, learnings). The critic, in fresh context, judges the work itself — did the thing you ASKED for actually happen, was each claim backed by a check that could have failed, did it stay in scope — and the score it gives is a byproduct of that verdict. The scorecard publishes both sides on one board with XP, levels, streaks and badges. Skills register as critic, mentor and scorecard; repo specifics live in .claude/KIT.md, and anything missing is named out loud rather than silently skipped.
